quality.review_scope: Independent source audit of all five supplied main pages, seven figures, three equations and the 40-entry bibliography passed, including bounded R3 stock-basis, supplied-electrolyte, characterization-stage and averaging-qualifier corrections. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Complete supplied five-page main only; SI and all cited full sources remain unreviewed.
Individual precursor and sucrose masses are not printed; source computes charges for a nominal 3 g LiMn2O4 target. No reagent masses or actual product yield are calculated here.
F:O is the total fuel/oxidizer redox-valence ratio, not a molar reagent ratio. LiNO3 in the formal reaction equation is not a separately reported purchased reagent charge.

Minimum dilute HNO3 volume/concentration, combustion duration and peak temperature, ignition source, cooling and powder collection are unreported. The 120 °C value is the electric-heater preparation condition, not an observed combustion temperature.
For annealing, portion mass/fraction, furnace geometry, heating/cooling rates and post-treatment handling are not stated. Physical batch IDs are absent.
Lattice parameters and source-inferred cation occupancies do not supply atom coordinates or refined measured atomic structures.
Molecular, unit-cell and particle illustrations remain presentation pending where not separately supplied.
Pellet mass, dimensions, pressing pressure/time and post-sintering particle-size/phase measurements are unreported.
